episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Xie Lian is summoned by Jun Wu to the Heavenly Realm where he's informed that a certain Heavenly Official needs to be rescued, so he goes to the Ghost Realm, the territory of the dead.

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: Xie Lian is summoned by Jun Wu to the Heavenly Realm where he's informed that a certain Heavenly Official needs to be rescued, so he goes to the Ghost Realm, the territory of the dead.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The Martial God of the East, Lang Qianqiu, causes a commotion in the ghost king's gambling hall, forcing Xie Lian to play a dice game against the king himself, Hua Cheng, to save his comrade.

tmdb.title: Episodio 2

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: A masked ghost leads Xie Lian to the Paradise Manor, where Hua Cheng is waiting for him. Later on, Xie Lian meets the bandaged boy from Yu Jun Mountain again and recalls a similar boy he met eight hundred years ago.

tmdb.title: Episodio 3

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: After infiltrating Paradise Manor and using a mysterious door granting access to various spaces depending on dice rolls, Xie Lian and Shi Qingxuan eventually reach the underground dungeon, where they discover the missing Heavenly Official.

tmdb.title: Episodio 4
tmdb.synopsis: After infiltrating Paradise Manor and using a mysterious door granting access to various spaces depending on dice rolls, Xie Lian and Shi Qingxuan eventually reach the underground dungeon, where they discover the missing Heavenly Official.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Back in the Heavenly Realm, Lang Qianqiu confronts Xie Lian about the true identity of the State Preceptor of Yong'an kingdom, Fang Xin, who massacred Yong'an's nobility and killed Lang Qianqiu's father, the king.

tmdb.title: Episodio 5

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Acknowledging his position as the State Preceptor, Xie Lian is apprehended and put under house arrest. He reflects on his haunted past before the doors of the Palace of Xianle are kicked open and silver butterflies swarm in.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: Acknowledging his position as the State Preceptor, Xie Lian is apprehended and put under house arrest. He reflects on his haunted past before the doors of the Palace of Xianle are kicked open and silver butterflies swarm in.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Hua Cheng leads Xie Lian away from the Heavenly Realm. Meanwhile, Feng Xin and Mu Qing encounter many obstacles while attempting to rescue him, and Lang Qianqiu has a plan of his own.

tmdb.title: Episodio 7

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Xie Lian and Hua Cheng enter the lair of the Night-Touring Green Lantern, Qi Rong. After a brief, violent confrontation, Qi Rong reveals the truth about the Yong'an massacre but other surprising truths are also told.

tmdb.title: Episodio 8
tmdb.synopsis: Xie Lian and Hua Cheng enter the lair of the Night-Touring Green Lantern, Qi Rong. After a brief, violent confrontation, Qi Rong reveals the truth about the Yong'an massacre but other surprising truths are also told.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Hua Cheng loses his composure and begins to violently assault Qi Rong. Qi Rong gives in and reveals the truth about the massacre at the Golden Feast... The truth is revealed about what happened in Yong An, which was supposed to have been heading towards peace, just before Lang Qianqiu was about to have his 17th Birthday...

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: An Le, a descendant of the imperial house of the fallen kingdom of Xian Le, was left in charge of preparations for the Golden Feast by the ruler of Yong An. While on the surface, An Le was a good friend to the Yong An Imperial Family, there was a darkness in his heart that Qi Rong took advantage of. When Fangxin (Xie Lian) arrives late to the banquet, he encounters something shocking, and is forced to make a choice...

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Xie Lian gets angry with Hua Cheng for revealing the truth about the Golden Feast Massacre to Lang Qianqiu. But Hua Cheng tells him plainly that Xie Lian did nothing wrong. When he realizes that Hua Cheng trusts him absolutely, and is the one person to see through to the truth of the matter, he says aloud that he wonders if they've met somewhere before...

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Xie Lian returns to the Heavenly Capital and tells Junwu the truth about the banquet massacre. The events have made Xie Lian trust Hua Cheng even more, but Junwu feels even more suspicious of him. Xie Lian leaves heaven and heads to the ruins of Xian Le. As he goes to see his parents' coffin, someone is waiting for him...

related.title: Tian Guan Ci Fu
related.plot: Per te, diventerò invincibile! “L’hai sentito? Quell’immondo Ufficiale Divino ha una storia col pezzo grosso del regno dei fantasmi!” Ottocento anni fa, Xie Lian era il Principe Ereditario del regno di Xian Le. La sua gente lo amava e lo considerava il tesoro del mondo. Non c’era da stupirsi se era asceso ai Cieli in giovane età. Ora, ottocento anni dopo, Xie Lian ascende ai Cieli per la terza volta come lo zimbello dei tre regni. Durante il suo primo incarico come divinità, incontra un misterioso fantasma che domina il regno dei fantasmi e terrorizza i Cieli… e che veglia su Xie Lian, a sua insaputa, da molto, molto tempo.
